Class StudentCounterVisitor

java.lang.Object
task1.StudentCounterVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
UniversityVisitor
public class StudentCounterVisitor extends Object implements UniversityVisitor
A Concrete Visitor (StudentCounterVisitor). Implements the logic to count the total number of Student elements.
